goddard-fortran-ecosystem/pfunit.manifest:
name="pfunit"
version="0.0.0"
license="Apache-2.0"
[library]
source-dir="playground-library"
include-dir=["include"]
[build]
auto-executables=false
auto-examples=false
auto-tests=false
external-modules=["mpi", "mpi_f08", "omp_lib", "fhamcrest", "pf_remoterunner", "pf_robustrunner", "f90_unix_proc"]
[install]
library=true
[dependencies]
fargparse={git="https://github.com/Goddard-Fortran-Ecosystem/fArgParse",rev="54c6066edb5bd9c2044274e13838db287ad947a3"}

gftl-shared={git="https://github.com/Goddard-Fortran-Ecosystem/gFTL-shared",rev="99dec0597bbd1df3f7b3bc46df930b46090ce509"}
[preprocess.cpp]
macros=["SKIP_FHAMCREST", "_DOUBLE_DEFAULT_KIND=8", "_GNU", "_INT_DEFAULT_KIND=4", "_ISO_INT16=2", "_ISO_INT32=4", "_ISO_INT64=8", "_ISO_INT8=1", "_ISO_REAL128=16", "_ISO_REAL32=4", "_ISO_REAL64=8", "_LOGICAL_DEFAULT_KIND=4", "_REAL128_IEEE_SUPPORT=T", "_REAL32_IEEE_SUPPORT=T", "_REAL64_IEEE_SUPPORT=T", "_REAL_DEFAULT_KIND=4"]
[fortran]
implicit-external=true

scope: The pinned serial pFUnit configuration disables MPI, OpenMP, robust/forked runners and Hamcrest, and uses the author-supported MAX_ASSERT_RANK=2 option (scalars, vectors and matrices) to retain the existing 2 MiB generated-source asset limit. The author CMake configuration supplies source selections and compiler-kind definitions; overload_template.py generates the assertions. fArgParse and its gFTL-shared/gFTL submodules are pinned at the exact upstream gitlinks, with only the required shared container instantiations generated. The FPM scanner sees a NAG-only f90_unix_proc USE even on GNU, so that inactive branch is declared external; inactive robust/Hamcrest interfaces are likewise excluded without altering original library code. A plain Fortran main constructs three TestMethod cases in a TestSuite and checks scalar, vector and matrix assertions through TestRunner/SerialContext, requiring exactly three runs and zero errors/failures. No visitor-side Python, CMake or annotation generation is needed. Higher assertion ranks, matcher DSLs, MPI, OpenMP and process-forking runners are not offered by this configuration. S denotes software testing; no numerical solver classification is inferred. Apache-2.0 and dependency notices are retained.

generation.rank_5_note: The observed rank-5 probe asset size includes Windows JSON line endings. It exceeded the existing 2 MiB text-asset cap. The supported rank-2 configuration is offered explicitly instead; no service limit changed.

wrapper_adjustments: Declare NAG-only f90_unix_proc as external because FPM scans the inactive conditional USE on GNU.
Set implicit-external=true for pFUnit, matching the upstream procedure() callback declarations rather than FPM strict implicit-interface diagnostics. Original source contents are unchanged.
